name: Grizmallt
description: Grizmallt was a war-torn planet in the Grizmallt system of the Core Worlds, and the origin of the humans who crash-landed on and colonized Naboo. Around 3900 BBY, a civil war on Grizmallt caused a group Grizmallti to flee their home in colony ships and settle on Naboo. Commissar was a position of authority on the planet.
